{{Quotation|game|The Henge of Denravi was once a sacred meeting place for the [[druid]]s of the [[Maguuma Jungle]]. It fell into disuse after the druids mysteriously disappeared more than a decade ago. The only way to enter the Henge is to be granted access through the Henge Gate, and only those who have already been to Denravi can find their way back.}}

The [[Henge of Denravi]] is the largest settlement in the Maguuma Jungle; however; it does not have as many [[non-player character|NPCs]] as the other [[town]]s.

==Getting there==
*[[Character]]s arrive here after completing the [[Aurora Glade]] mission.

==Notes==
{{gw2w|The Shattered Henge|3=}}
*Despite the map description saying "''The only way to enter the Henge is to be granted access through the Henge Gate''", the player can simply walk in from Tangle Root at any time, even before completing the Aurora Glade mission.
**Canonically, [[White Mantle]] also enter the Henge and capture the Shining Blade leadership off-screen during the [[Sanctum Cay]] mission, suggesting that there may be other ways to enter.
*Totally explored, Henge of Denravi adds approx. 0.3% to the [[Cartographer]] title.
*One of the world arenas, [[Fort Koga]] stood right next to Henge of Denravi, but after the release of Competition Arenas, it was blocked off.
*In the quest [[For Your Ears Only]], Heket will discuss a shipment containing Denravi Axes.
